title: **SPORTS DIPLOMACY: IRAN LOOKS TO SOUTH ASIA TO DEVELOP CRICKET**
text:
**SPORTS DIPLOMACY: IRAN LOOKS TO SOUTH ASIA TO DEVELOP CRICKET**"

""
"**Tehran, October 23, 2026** — A friendly cricket match between the Iran Cricket Association and a team representing the Indian Embassy was held at Velayat Park in southern Tehran on Friday, offering a glimpse of efforts to expand the sport’s presence in Iran through international sporting exchanges."

"The match comes amid a series of recent contacts between Iran’s cricket authorities and South Asian partners. In August, the Pakistan Cricket Board held talks with an Iranian delegation on coaching support, player development, infrastructure and equipment. In September, the Bangladeshi Embassy in Tehran also reported discussions with the head of the Iran Cricket Association on strengthening cooperation in cricket."

"Cricket remains a relatively niche sport in Iran. The International Cricket Council notes that the game has traditionally had a stronger presence among expatriates in Tehran, while activity has also grown in southern regions bordering Pakistan."

"Against this background, friendly matches and sporting exchanges could provide opportunities to build contacts, share expertise and attract new participants. The Tehran match, however, was a friendly fixture, not an official international competition."

"**Potential focus:** Can sporting exchanges with India, Pakistan and Bangladesh help Iran build a broader domestic cricket base?
